Carry out daily food manufacturing operations in accordance with SOPs and work instructions.
Perform routine tasks such as processing, packing, cleaning, and sanitation.
Maintain food safety, hygiene, quality, and safety standards at all times.
Observe and report abnormalities in process, quality, or equipment.
Record daily operational data as required.
Support team activities to ensure smooth food manufacturing operations.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

* Operate and monitor production machinery and technical equipment according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Perform routine checks, maintenance, and troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* Identify and resolve technical issues and equipment malfunctions promptly to minimize downtime.
* Collaborate with production teams to optimize equipment performance and process efficiency.
* Maintain accurate records of equipment operation, maintenance activities, and technical issues.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies in all technical operations.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to technical processes and equipment.
* Assist in the installation and commissioning of new equipment as required.
* Report any major technical breakdowns or safety concerns to the appropriate supervisor.
